title: Which month will the Palestinian Football Association announce for the resumption of its football competitions after their October 2023 suspension?
background: Palestinian football competitions have been suspended since the war in Gaza began in October 2023.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : An official Palestinian Football Association announcement, or reliable news reporting quoting its leadership. 
  Resolution Conditions : Use the first public announcement between July 1 and August 31, 2026, that specifies a date for restarting the suspended football competitions. Resolve to the calendar month containing that announced restart date, regardless of whether competitions subsequently begin as scheduled. If no qualifying announcement occurs by the deadline, the question is void. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The full English name of the month, not the month in which the announcement is made.
